description: Section 9A.6, step 13: the line items of the acts a SessionEvidenceRecord records are held to Section 7.2. At every record_version a money hazard is refused: a bare unit_price or total, or a unit_price_minor or total_minor that is present but not an integer by value. From record_version "0.5" the whole line-item rule applies as well: both pinned keys present, line_items an array of objects, and the quantity rules. Each case is session-evidence-record-parity.json's stored "0.1" record, or the "0.5" record generated for the same session, with the observed counteroffer's terms.line_items set as the case says, its act hash and the chain recomputed, and the record resealed with that vector's test-only producer key. Verified with did_documents, each record must reach the stated verdict in both implementations.

cases.name: pre_0_5_missing_total_minor
cases.description: A line with unit_price_minor and no total_minor, as records written before 0.5 carry: before 0.5 only the money hazards are refused.

cases.name: pre_0_5_bare_names
cases.description: A bare unit_price / total is a money hazard, refused at every version, so an older label cannot get one past the check.

cases.name: pre_0_5_bare_name_beside_pinned
cases.description: A bare name is refused even beside the pinned keys.

cases.name: pre_0_5_fractional_minor
cases.description: A pinned amount that is present must be an integer by value, at every version.

cases.name: missing_total_minor
cases.description: From 0.5 both pinned keys are REQUIRED.

cases.name: bare_names
cases.description: A bare unit_price / total is refused.

cases.name: fractional_minor
cases.description: A fractional pinned amount is refused.
